description: Rate a host reply from 1 to 5 with fixed tags that tune your own future tone, length, theme and activity. Optional text is moderated and discarded. Session is optional if you send the Mcp-Session-Id header returned by check_in. Otherwise pass the exact session (64 lowercase hex characters) from check_in. An explicit session takes precedence over the header. Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. Keep it private and out of URLs.
